anchors.the_one_marked_specimen: s04 (Black Forest Labs gallery, sha256 e6e069a7...): valid C2PA manifest, signer 'Black Forest Labs Inc.', claim generator 'Black Forest Labs API' with 'Flux.1', assertion c2pa.actions.v2 action c2pa.created with digitalSourceType trainedAlgorithmicMedia, plus a c2pa.ai_generated_content assertion. Signature timestamp 2025-11-18T12:17:34+00:00, which would place the marking roughly eight and a half months before the seam - but TWO untrusted findings must be read with it (Skeptic blocking condition 2): top-level validation_status 'signingCredential.untrusted' (signing certificate untrusted - the instrument-014 caveat: 'Valid' means the signature verifies, not that the signer is on a trust list; no trust-list arm was run here), and informational 'timeStamp.untrusted' (the timestamping authority's certificate is likewise untrusted, though 'timeStamp.validated' succeeds, so the digest does match). The manifest content is also generic - title 'sample.png', prompt 'AI generated image' - consistent with static demonstration content, though assertion.dataHash.match binds it to exactly these bytes. NARROWED CLAIM: the file carries a valid, synthetic-asserting manifest whose own timestamp claims a date well before the seam, on an authority not trusted here. No rate, no label, no compliance inference.
